page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.25 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified as memory-optimized. The high memory density relative to the dedicated AMD EPYC processor cores makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory footprints without the need for local physical storage or GPU acceleration.
